name: MonarchConsequenceList
title: ConsequenceList
summary: A list of what an action deletes, changes and keeps, and what to know first, to read before confirming.
whenToUse: Inside a confirmation dialog or a destructive flow, such as deleting a project or removing a member, to state plainly what will happen.
whenNotToUse: For a single sentence of warning, use the text of the dialog or MonarchInlineNotice. For a list of errors, use the error states of the form.
api: @Composable fun MonarchConsequenceList(items: List<MonarchConsequence>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, grouped: Boolean = false, loading: Boolean = false, heading: String? = null, icon: (@Composable (MonarchConsequenceKind) -> Unit)? = null, loadingRowCount: Int = MonarchConsequenceListTokens.DEFAULT_LOADING_ROWS, kindLabel: ((MonarchConsequenceKind) -> String)? = null, groupTitle: ((MonarchConsequenceKind) -> String)? = null, loadingLabel: String? = null)
class MonarchConsequence(val kind: MonarchConsequenceKind, val label: String, val detail: String? = null, val count: Int? = null, val id: String? = null)
enum class MonarchConsequenceKind { Removed, Changed, Warning, Kept }

options.name: grouped
options.description: Splits the items under a heading per kind: removed, changed, warning, kept.

options.name: loading
options.description: Shows placeholder rows instead of the items.

options.name: heading
options.description: A heading above the list, such as "What happens".

options.name: icon
options.description: The icon of a kind, tinted by kind and hidden from TalkBack. Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: loadingRowCount
options.description: Placeholder rows while loading. Values below 1 count as 1.

options.name: kindLabel
options.description: The word read before an ungrouped row. null uses monarch_consequencelist_kind_*.

options.name: groupTitle
options.description: The heading of a group. null uses monarch_consequencelist_group_*.

options.name: loadingLabel
options.description: What TalkBack reads for the placeholder rows. null uses monarch_consequencelist_loading.

states.name: ungrouped
states.description: Rows in the given order; TalkBack reads the kind before each row.

states.name: grouped
states.description: One block per kind that has items, under its heading, in the order removed, changed, warning, kept.

states.name: loading
states.description: Placeholder rows that shimmer unless animations are off, read as one element.

appearance: Rows of body text in the default text color with muted caption details. The count is semibold with tabular figures, in the danger strong color for removed items. Icons are danger strong for removed, muted for changed, warning strong for warnings and success strong for kept. Group headings are muted label text. The same roles in every theme.
platformNotes: The web error slot is not offered: when the consequences cannot be worked out, show MonarchInlineErrorRetry in place of the list. Monarch bundles no icons, so the per-kind icons the web draws are a slot that receives the kind; without it, the label must say what happens. The count is formatted with java.text.NumberFormat in the locale of the configuration; there is no locale parameter. label and detail are Strings where the web takes any content. The heading level option has no equivalent: headings are marked as headings. The loading rows are MonarchSkeleton, as on the web; iOS uses the system redaction.
accessibility: Each row is one TalkBack element. Ungrouped, it is read as the kind word, the count and label, then the detail.
Grouped, the kind word is left out of the row, because the group heading says it; group headings and the list heading are marked as headings.
With icons, each kind has its own shape, so the kind does not depend on color. Icons are hidden from TalkBack.
While loading, the placeholder rows are one element read as "Checking what will change". Nothing is announced when loading starts or ends.
Text wraps and is not cut off at the largest font size.
edgeCases: Without icons, ungrouped rows have no visual kind marker other than the color of a removed count; write the label so it says what happens.
Kinds with no items have no group and no heading.
Large counts are grouped by the locale, for example 12,000.

examples.title: Mixed consequences
examples.template:
MonarchConsequenceList(
    items = listOf(
        MonarchConsequence(MonarchConsequenceKind.{{items.0.kind|pascal}}, {{items.0.label}}, count = {{items.0.count}}, id = {{items.0.id}}),
        MonarchConsequence(MonarchConsequenceKind.{{items.1.kind|pascal}}, {{items.1.label}}, count = {{items.1.count}}, id = {{items.1.id}}),
        MonarchConsequence(MonarchConsequenceKind.{{items.2.kind|pascal}}, {{items.2.label}}, count = {{items.2.count}}, id = {{items.2.id}}),
        MonarchConsequence(MonarchConsequenceKind.{{items.3.kind|pascal}}, {{items.3.label}}, detail = {{items.3.detail}}, id = {{items.3.id}}),
        MonarchConsequence(MonarchConsequenceKind.{{items.4.kind|pascal}}, {{items.4.label}}, id = {{items.4.id}}),
    ),
    heading = {{heading}},
)
examples.code:
MonarchConsequenceList(
    items = listOf(
        MonarchConsequence(MonarchConsequenceKind.Removed, "tasks and their comments will be deleted", count = 48, id = "tasks"),
        MonarchConsequence(MonarchConsequenceKind.Removed, "files will be deleted", count = 1312, id = "files"),
        MonarchConsequence(MonarchConsequenceKind.Changed, "people lose access immediately", count = 6, id = "access"),
        MonarchConsequence(MonarchConsequenceKind.Kept, "Invoices are kept for 7 years", detail = "They stay available to workspace owners under Billing.", id = "invoices"),
        MonarchConsequence(MonarchConsequenceKind.Warning, "Shared links stop working", id = "links"),
    ),
    heading = "What happens",
)

examples.title: Grouped, while the counts load
examples.code:
MonarchConsequenceList(
    items = listOf(
        MonarchConsequence(MonarchConsequenceKind.Removed, "files will be deleted", count = 12),
        MonarchConsequence(MonarchConsequenceKind.Warning, "This cannot be undone"),
    ),
    grouped = true,
    loading = loading,
)
